title: THE WATER GATE — THIRTY SECONDS TO SAVE THE STREET
subtitle: A fictional Roman engineering rescue; stylized reconstruction, NOT a documented historical event.

beats.text: Below it, a crowded street stood in danger.
Livia saw the stone begin to give way.
She shouted, Close the upper gate!
The wheel jammed. Two workers pushed together.
At last, the gate dropped into place.
The torrent turned toward the overflow channel.
